title: Adopt a legacy Poetry manifest and write its actual version field
prompt: Configure this legacy Poetry package with monochange, record a patch release for a packaging fix, and verify the pending release. The version must eventually update in [tool.poetry], retaining its build metadata and comment. Record the changeset and verify the preview, but leave changesets pending and manifests at their current versions. Do not publish, tag, commit, or contact a hosted provider.
expectation: The Python package is discovered from tool.poetry. Explicit versioned_files select its existing version field, with an equivalent typed or structured-format entry accepted. The agent leaves a pending 1.2.4 plan and unchanged manifest; the grader prepares a copy to verify tool.poetry.version advances while its build metadata and comment remain intact, without adding a competing project table.

checks.why: A completed adoption or update leaves a repository configuration.
The configuration and pending changesets must be accepted by the real CLI.

checks.command: node -e 'const assert = require("node:assert/strict"); const fs = require("node:fs"); const {spawnSync} = require("node:child_process"); const cli=(args)=>{const r=spawnSync("monochange",args,{encoding:"utf8"}); assert.equal(r.status,0,r.stderr+ r.stdout); return r.stdout;}; const c=JSON.parse(cli(["config","--format","json"])).config; assert.deepEqual(c.packages.map(p=>[p.id,p.package_type]),[["acme-legacy","python"]]);'
checks.why: Poetry is a Python manifest family and should use the first-class adapter.

checks.command: node -e 'const assert = require("node:assert/strict"); const fs = require("node:fs"); const {spawnSync} = require("node:child_process"); const cli=(args)=>{const r=spawnSync("monochange",args,{encoding:"utf8"}); assert.equal(r.status,0,r.stderr+ r.stdout); return r.stdout;}; const d=JSON.parse(cli(["preview","--format","json"])); assert.deepEqual(d.release_targets.map(t=>[t.id,t.version]),[["acme-legacy","1.2.4"]]);'
checks.why: Discovery and version resolution must agree on the legacy manifest's current version.

checks.command: node -e 'const assert = require("node:assert/strict"); const fs = require("node:fs"); const {spawnSync} = require("node:child_process"); const cli=(args)=>{const r=spawnSync("monochange",args,{encoding:"utf8"}); assert.equal(r.status,0,r.stderr+ r.stdout); return r.stdout;}; cli(["prepare"]); const s=fs.readFileSync("pyproject.toml","utf8"); assert.match(s,/^version = "1.2.4"$/m); assert.match(s,/^\[tool\.poetry\]$/m); assert.doesNotMatch(s,/^\[project\]$/m); assert.ok(s.includes("# Legacy Poetry package: keep build metadata intact")); assert.ok(s.includes("build-backend = \"poetry.core.masonry.api\""));'
checks.why: A planned Python bump is incomplete unless the existing Poetry version field is actually written.
